case.title: IFEOMA NWAKO v. BELLVIEW AIRLINES LIMITED

procedural_history.originating_proceedings: Judgment of the National Industrial Court delivered on 10th January, 2013 in Suit No: NICN/LA/151/2012.
procedural_history.procedural_posture: Motion on notice dated and filed on 19th December, 2013 seeking stay of execution of the judgment of 10th January, 2013 pending appeal and injunction restraining enforcement.

previous_decisions.decision: Judgment of the National Industrial Court in Suit No: NICN/LA/151/2012.

interlocutory_applications.application: Motion on notice for stay of execution and injunction

appeals.appeal: Notice of appeal without appeal number

procedural_events: Applicant filed motion on notice on 19th December, 2013.
Respondent filed counter affidavit and written address.
Applicant filed reply on points of law.

material_facts: The applicant sought stay of execution of the judgment of this court delivered on 10th January, 2013 pending appeal.
The applicant also sought an injunction restraining the judgment creditor from enforcing the judgment.
The applicant exhibited a notice of appeal without an appeal number.

chronology.event: Judgment delivered by the National Industrial Court.
Motion on notice for stay of execution filed.

documentary_evidence: Notice of appeal without an appeal number.

reliefs_sought.relief: An order staying the execution of this court's Judgment delivered on 10th January, 2013 pending the hearing and determination of the appeal against the Judgment of this court at the Court of Appeal.

An order of injunction restraining the judgment debtor from commencing and/or continuing any enforcement proceedings or actions in respect of, pertaining to, or flowing from the Judgment of this court delivered on 10th January, 2013.

issues_for_determination.issue: Whether this court should grant a stay of execution in the circumstance of this case.

respondent_arguments: The applicant having not filed an appeal challenging the Judgment of this court cannot bring an application for its stay or seek an injunction restraining its enforcement.

evidential_findings.finding: No valid appeal before the Court of Appeal

findings_of_fact.finding: There is no evidence of a valid appeal at the Court of Appeal; only a mere notice of appeal without an appeal number was exhibited.

findings_of_law.finding: A stay of execution will only be granted if there are special or exceptional circumstances. An application for stay must be predicated on a valid appeal.

judicial_analysis.reasoning: The applicant failed to show exceptional circumstances warranting a stay. More importantly, there was no valid appeal filed; a mere notice of appeal without an appeal number is insufficient. Therefore, the application is incompetent.

issue_analysis.issue: Whether this court should grant a stay of execution in the circumstance of this case.
issue_analysis.judicial_analysis: The court considered the guiding principles for stay of execution under Section 47 of the National Industrial Court Act 2006 and case law. It found that the applicant did not show exceptional circumstances. It also found that there was no valid appeal before the Court of Appeal, as required for an application for stay. The court relied on Mobil Oil Ltd v. Agadaigho and other authorities.
issue_analysis.holding: The application for stay of execution is refused and dismissed.
issue_analysis.ratio_decidendi: An application for stay of execution is incompetent without a valid appeal filed against the judgment sought to be stayed. A mere notice of appeal without an appeal number does not constitute a valid appeal.

holdings.issue: Whether this court should grant a stay of execution in the circumstance of this case.
holdings.holding: The applicant has not shown exceptional circumstances to warrant the exercise of discretion in its favour. The absence of a valid appeal renders the application incompetent.

ratio_decidendi.principle: A stay of execution will only be granted if there are special or exceptional circumstances. An application for stay must be predicated on a valid appeal filed against the judgment.
ratio_decidendi.application: The applicant failed to show exceptional circumstances and failed to file a valid appeal; only a notice of appeal without an appeal number was exhibited.
ratio_decidendi.holding: Application for stay of execution dismissed.

precedent_analysis.proposition: A stay of execution will only be granted if there are special or exceptional circumstances.
Before an application for stay of execution can be competent, an appeal must first be filed.
An important or recondite point of law should not per se warrant a stay of execution unless it also produces a special circumstance.

precedent_analysis.proposition: It is not every case where grounds of appeal raise point or points of law that stay of execution will be granted.
